en.summary: Build and publish a Git repository on Makers
details: Let Makers build and publish after a source push. Prepare the repository, deployment branch, project root, install and build commands, output directory and tool versions.
swcl prepares CLI tools as needed. If authorization is missing, run swcl edgeone/auth/setup, then check identity and project access below.
1. Connect the Git repository:

Run swcl edgeone/auth/setup and select Git repositories. The user authorizes repository access, connects the project and selects its deployment branch in the console, then provides the project ID. Existing upload projects can connect under Settings → Git management. Operate the web UI only when explicitly requested.

CLI 1.7.2 makers link links a local directory, not a Git repository. The public SDK has no documented repository import, deployment branch setting or authorized-repository listing entry. whoami and project lists do not verify repository access.
swcl edgeone/cli whoami --json  #Check query identity and workspace
swcl edgeone/cli --help         #Show current native commands
Use Makers SDK projects.list/get to check the target project ID; SDK prerequisites are below.
Connection guide: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/importing-a-git-repository
2. Configure the platform build:

Call Makers SDK from a script. swcl does not wrap or prepare the SDK. Configure authentication and site as specified by the SDK; do not assume scripts inherit CLI sign-in or the Token saved by the authorization page.

Use Makers SDK projects.update to set rootDir, installCmd, buildCmd and outputDir, sending only fields to change. These settings are also available in the console. No edgeone.json is required for them. Command paths are relative to the selected project root.
For an existing scripts/build.sh that writes to dist, set the build command to sh scripts/build.sh and the output directory to dist. Set the install command as needed.

To version configuration with source, commit edgeone.json at the project root. Its buildCommand, installCommand and outputDirectory override platform settings. Omit these fields from the file when using platform settings.

In a Makers Git build tested on 2026-11-14, root edgeone.json supplied headers and redirects; generated public/edgeone.json was not applied, even without a root file. Keep delivery rules in the project-root config for Git builds. When uploading dist directly, dist is the upload root.

Commit the build script and verify a clean local build. Configure platform tool versions, environment variables and private dependency access; check the command, version and output in the first build log.
Configuration: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/edgeone-json
3. Trigger a build and check deployment:
Trigger by pushing a new commit to the connected repository branch, calling a deployment webhook, or creating/retrying a deployment in the console.

Create a webhook and select its branch under project settings → Webhook. Store its URL in the local EDGEONE_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL environment variable and send HTTP POST; no EdgeOne CLI or SDK is needed. The URL grants trigger access; keep it out of repositories and logs.
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $env:EDGEONE_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL  #Build the webhook branch

The current public SDK deployments.deploy accepts files, directories or ZIP archives, not a Git branch build request. Check deployment records separately for push and webhook triggers; HTTP success does not mean build success.
Trigger methods: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/create-deploys
After triggering a build, inspect deployments.list/get/getLog or the console.

Check commit, branch, environment, logs and URL to confirm the deployed version. If no build starts, check GitHub application access and branch settings. If it fails, check tool versions, private dependencies and output directory.
swcl help/en edgeone/deploy/upload  #Read the built-output upload workflow
Project queries: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/project-operations
Deployments and logs: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/deployment

zh.summary: 配置并检查 Makers Git 托管构建
details: 让 Makers 在源码推送后构建和发布。先准备仓库、部署分支、项目根目录、安装与构建命令、输出目录及工具版本。
CLI 工具由 swcl 按需准备；尚未授权时运行 swcl edgeone/auth/setup，随后用下方身份和项目查询核对访问范围。
1. 连接 Git 仓库：
运行 swcl edgeone/auth/setup，选择“Git 仓库”。由用户在控制台授权仓库、关联项目并选择部署分支，然后提供项目 ID。已有上传项目可在“设置 → Git 管理”中关联仓库；仅在用户明确要求时接管网页操作。
CLI 1.7.2 的 makers link 关联本地目录，不关联 Git 仓库。公开 SDK 尚无仓库导入、部署分支设置或授权仓库列表入口；whoami 和项目列表不能验证仓库权限。
swcl edgeone/cli whoami --json  #核对查询身份与工作区
swcl edgeone/cli --help         #查看当前原生命令能力
用 Makers SDK projects.list/get 核对目标项目 ID；SDK 的使用前提见下方。
接入流程：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/importing-a-git-repository
2. 设置平台构建：
Makers SDK 需在脚本中调用，swcl 不提供 SDK 命令包装或自动准备。按官方 SDK 文档配置认证和站点，不假定脚本会自动复用 CLI 登录态或授权页保存的 Token。
用 Makers SDK projects.update 设置 rootDir、installCmd、buildCmd、outputDir；只提交本次要改的字段。控制台的构建部署配置也可设置这些值，无需为此新增 edgeone.json。命令路径相对于选定的项目根目录。
例如，仓库已有 scripts/build.sh 且输出到 dist 时，构建命令填 sh scripts/build.sh，输出目录填 dist；安装命令按项目需要填写。
如需随代码管理配置，可在项目根目录提交 edgeone.json。其中 buildCommand、installCommand、outputDirectory 会覆盖平台对应设置；使用平台设置时，省略文件中的这些字段。
2026-11-14 实测 Makers Git 构建：根目录 edgeone.json 的 headers 和 redirects 生效；构建生成的 public/edgeone.json 未被应用，即使根目录没有配置也如此。Git 构建需将交付规则放在项目根目录配置中。直接上传 dist 时，dist 才是上传包根目录。
提交构建脚本并验证干净检出的本地构建。配置平台工具版本、环境变量及私有依赖权限，首次构建再核对日志中的命令、版本和产物。
配置说明：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/edgeone-json
3. 触发构建并检查发布：
触发方式：向已关联的仓库分支推送新提交、调用部署钩子，或在控制台新建部署、重新部署。
部署钩子：在项目设置的“部署钩子 / Webhook”中创建钩子并选择分支。将 URL 放入本地环境变量 EDGEONE_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL，再发送 HTTP POST；不需要 edgeone CLI 或 SDK。钩子 URL 本身具有触发权限，不写入仓库或日志。
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $env:EDGEONE_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL  #触发钩子对应分支的构建
当前公开 SDK 的 deployments.deploy 接收文件、目录或 ZIP，不是 Git 分支构建触发接口。推送触发和钩子触发应分别核对部署记录；HTTP 请求成功不代表构建成功。
触发方式：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/create-deploys
触发构建后，用 deployments.list/get/getLog 或控制台查询部署。
核对提交版本、分支、环境、日志和访问地址，确认发布的是本次提交。未触发构建时检查 GitHub 应用权限与部署分支；构建失败时检查工具版本、私有依赖和输出目录。
swcl help/zh edgeone/deploy/upload  #查看已构建产物上传方案
项目查询：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/project-operations
部署与日志：https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/deployment
